title: POS Session Lifecycle (open/close/reconcile → account.move generation)
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

session_state_machine.bypass: If cash_control=False, closing_control is bypassed; session goes directly to close

key_findings.account_move_creation_timing: Single account.move created at session close in _create_account_move, NOT per-order. Per-order invoice created only if to_invoice=True via _generate_pos_order_invoice.

cash_control.cash_difference: _post_statement_difference creates account.bank.statement.line using cash journal loss_account_id or profit_account_id

multi_payment_method.cash_type: is_cash_count=True; payments create cash statement lines and cash receivable lines in session move
multi_payment_method.bank_type: Payments create account.payment records via _create_bank_payment_moves; routed through outstanding_account_id
multi_payment_method.pay_later_type: Creates pay-later receivable lines in session move

inventory_cogs_impact.stock_picking_batch: Created at session close in _create_picking_at_end_of_session if update_stock_at_closing=True
inventory_cogs_impact.cogs_in_session_move: Included for storable products with valuation=real_time; uses product expense and stock_valuation accounts from _get_product_accounts

key_findings.reconciliation: After session move is posted, _reconcile_account_move_lines reconciles cash receivables, bank payment receivables, and invoice receivables in one plan pass (no_cash_basis=True)
